description: Voice lowered, hands visible, distance kept, smile held - unpaid, constant impression management that nobody else in the lift is performing.

aspect: The cost is highest where the stakes are
description: In the traffic stop, the interview and the emergency room, the performance has to be perfect at exactly the moment he is most frightened.
energy_note: Must appear calmest when most afraid.

aspect: Anger is unavailable to him as a response
description: Legitimate anger confirms the stereotype and escalates the risk, so the ordinary human response to unfair treatment is closed off.
energy_note: Not allowed the reaction anyone else would have.

description: A woman gets in on the fourth floor and he watches her decide something about him. He takes his hands out of his pockets, looks at his phone, and stands nearer the buttons than the wall. He is a quantity surveyor and he is forty-three.
energy_note: Rearranging himself in a lift, at forty-three.
